title: Lightly Smoked Mexican Broccoli Skillet
description: A citrusy and springy Mexican dish featuring purple sprouting broccoli, smoked with binchotan charcoal for a nostalgic flavor, made in an iron teppan for an ayurvedic rajasic friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the olive oil and swirl it around to coat the teppan.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the trimmed broccoli and cook until it is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Smoke the broccoli mixture with the binchotan charcoal for 2 minutes, until lightly smoked.
Remove the teppan from the heat and stir in the lime juice.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with lime wedges if desired.
